visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a sunlit outdoor park. A young boy with glasses and a black t-shirt is seen running along a stone path towards the camera. The background features lush green trees and a playground structure with blue metal bars. A woman, wearing a cream-colored shirt and sunglasses, smiles warmly and embraces the boy as he reaches her. Yellow captions appear at the top of the frame. (2) The scene shifts to an indoor laundry area with tiled walls and a balcony view. The woman is seen inspecting a damp grey t-shirt hanging on a rack above a white washing machine. She then opens a wooden drawer filled with neatly folded colorful clothes, including blue, red, and green items. Her facial expression shows concern as she sniffs a garment. Bright indoor lighting illuminates the scene. (3) The camera focuses on the Orange House detergent products. A large white bottle with an orange logo and a square box of laundry pods are positioned on a wooden surface near the washing machine. The woman's hands are visible pouring a bright yellow liquid detergent into a white cap. The liquid is clear and viscous. Green and orange laundry pods are shown in a close-up, held by the woman's fingers. (4) A split-screen comparison shows a black t-shirt with visible white sweat stains in the top half labeled with variety text. The bottom half shows the same shirt looking perfectly clean. Later, the woman and the boy are back indoors, holding a fresh purple shirt. They both smile at the camera, looking relieved and happy. The background shows blurred household items. (5) Back in the park, the boy is shown playing on a silver metal swing under the shade of large trees. He grips the rope handles tightly and swings back and forth. The scene then cuts back to the indoor setting where the woman and boy are together, looking at a clean black shirt. The lighting is soft and warm, emphasizing a domestic, comfortable atmosphere.
